title: My wife believed in me before I believed in myself.
summary: Before the company became successful, there was uncertainty, sacrifice, and someone willing to keep believing.
quote: She saw something in me I couldn’t see in myself. Her belief didn’t change my circumstances—it changed my direction.
body:
Long before the business, the tools, or the title—there was a moment. Someone believed when there was nothing to prove and no reason for anyone else to believe.

Success is easy to see. The beginning usually is not. Jesse’s story goes back to the season when his wife carried more than the bills. She carried a future he could not yet imagine.
